title: The Great Leo Full Moon Recharge
skyStory: Full moon, one hundred percent, and it has strutted into Leo like a lion walking onto a stage it built itself. Leo wants applause. Leo wants a spotlight. Leo wants your ruby and your onyx lined up on the windowsill like royal guests. This is the Full Moon Recharge, and the whole sky has dressed up. Saturn wore a tie. Mars wore a crown.

reading: Big night. Remember the idea you tucked under your onyx on January 6 and promised not to reread? The moon is full. Unfold it. Read it out loud to the room. Whatever it says, it has been growing in the dark for sixteen days, and tonight Leo is ready to give it a standing ovation.

Then the recharge. Take the onyx off your wrist and set it on the windowsill in the moonlight. Nancy will set her ruby out too, miles away. Fire sign moon, fire stone, Fire Tiger. [[The Sun]], reversed in your spread, asks you to allow joy without earning it. Tonight is the allowing. Leave the bracelet out until morning.
joel.mission: Reread the idea from January 6 out loud, then leave your onyx in the moonlight overnight without checking on it.
joel.omen: A cloud passing over the full moon and leaving it brighter. It means the idea you reread tonight is ready.
joel.stoneWhy: the bracelet takes a moon bath

reading: The moon is fullest tonight, in Leo, and it wants you on stage. Leo is a fire sign, and your ruby is a fire stone, which makes your pinky ring the headliner. Before bed, slip off all five stones and set them in a ring in the moonlight, ruby pointing north like a compass needle: earth, fire, water, wind, heart. The Wood Rat knows exactly how they should be arranged.

Across the miles, Joel's onyx will be sitting in the same moonlight. Equinox and solstice, Mars and Saturn, recharging side by side. The [[Knight of Pentacles]], reversed, reminds you this is not something you earned. It is just yours. Look at the row of stones once more and grin.
nancy.mission: Arrange your stones in a ring with the ruby pointing straight at the moon, then give the ring a royal name before you photograph it.
nancy.omen: A dog or cat staring at the moon. It means the recharge is working, and the animals can tell.

together.text: Full Moon Recharge. Set your stones on the windowsill at the same minute, 9:22 pm, by text countdown. Send one photo each of the moonlit stones. Then say goodnight like royalty: grandly, with at least one ridiculous title. Leo insists on titles tonight.

game.intro: Full moon in Leo! Ruby and onyx are recharging on the sill and the studio lion wants a turn at the mic.
game.prompt: A lion trying to roar politely so it doesn't wake the neighbours.
